items.description: Cows per full-time-equivalent labour unit on NZ dairy farms (DairyBase owner-operator sample), 2024-25 season
items.note: Derived by reading the text: "the number of cows per full-time equivalent (FTE) labour unit decreased from 147 to 141. However, since 2023-24 the number has increased and in the 2024-25 season it reached the same level as in the 2019-20 season" (147 in 2019-20, so 147 in 2024-25). Graph 3.4 Cows per FTE. Range over the series: 141 (2022-23) to 147.

items.description: Range of cows per FTE over 2019-20 to 2024-25 (DairyBase)
items.note: "decreased from 147 to 141 ... in the 2024-25 season it reached the same level as in the 2019-20 season" (Economic Survey 2024-25, section 3.3).

"There were 10,485 herds this season - 116 fewer than the previous season. The national average herd size was 448"; Table 2.2 row 2023/24: 10,485 herds, 4,701,596 cows, 1,703,404 effective ha, average 162 ha, 2.76 cows/ha.

items.description: RNZCGP-recommended enrolled patients per GP, as quoted by the Ministry of Health
items.note: "The Royal New Zealand College of General Practitioners (RNZCGP) recommends approximately one GP to 1300-1500 patients"; also "There is no maximum number of patients allowed per GP or Nurse Practitioner".

items.description: Marsden Point refinery throughput, FY2019 (pre-COVID, last full normal year)
items.note: FY2020 results table: "Refinery Throughput Mbbl 42.7 29.9 12.8 30%" (FY19 42.7, FY20 29.9). 42.7 Mbbl/yr is about 117 kbbl/day (derived: 42.7e6 / 365).

items.description: Refining NZ employees who left or were leaving in the 2020-21 restructure (about a 25% staff reduction)
items.note: "c.25% reduction in staff" with footnote "c.90 employees left or leaving Refining NZ either through redundancy or resignation from November 2020 through to April 2021". Implies roughly 360 staff before the cut (derived, 90/0.25).

items.description: Marsden Point refinery employees in Aug 2021 before conversion to an import terminal
items.note: "It currently employs around 300 people, with 240 jobs likely to go."

items.description: Derived Marsden Point staffing intensity: about 300 employees over FY2019 throughput of about 117 kbbl/day
items.note: Derivation only: 300 employees (1news2021) / (42.7e6 bbl / 365 d / 1000 = 117.0 kbbl/d) = 2.56. Mixes a 2021 headcount (after cuts) with FY2019 throughput; contractors excluded. Using the c.360 pre-cut implied headcount gives about 3.1.

items.description: Marsden Point site workforce (staff plus contractors) normally and during a major turnaround
items.note: "the shutdown will see staff and contractor numbers at the refinery swell from 500-plus to around 1200". Article undated (refers to a first full-refinery shutdown in 14 years); includes contractors.
"Woolworths New Zealand proudly owns and operates over 185 supermarkets in New Zealand." (the figure is a lower bound: 'over 185').

items.description: Woolworths NZ total team, including support offices, processing plants and distribution centres
items.note: "20,000 New Zealanders employed in our stores, support offices, processing plants and distribution centres."

items.description: Upper-bound staff per supermarket derived from company totals
items.note: Derived: 20,000 / 185 = 108. Overstates in-store staff because the 20,000 includes support offices, processing plants and four dry grocery distribution centres; actual in-store headcount per store is lower. No per-store or per-m2 figure was found.
